story.iWant: a portable baseline test suite that validates the plugin system
story.soThat: any CI/CD pipeline can execute quality gates without infrastructure coupling
story.tasks:
### Setup Test Infrastructure - Install test frameworks (Jest, Playwright, k6) - Configure test reporters for CI compatibility - Create test directory structure
### Implement Monorepo Validation Tests - Create monorepo structure tests - Test workspace linking - Verify TypeScript project references
### Implement Import Boundary Tests - Create boundary validation tests - Test IP protection boundaries - Verify ESLint catches violations
### Implement Build Verification Tests - Create build validation tests - Test package publishing readiness - Check subpath exports work
### Implement Performance Baseline Tests - Create legacy provider benchmarks - Measure OpenAI legacy provider latency - Save baseline metrics to JSON file
### Implement Integration Tests - Create plugin discovery tests - Create plugin registry tests - Create hot-reload simulation tests
### Create NPM Scripts - Add test scripts to package.json - Configure test environments - Set up test data fixtures
### Documentation and Reporting - Create test documentation - Configure test reporting - Performance metrics dashboard

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. **npm run test:baseline** executes all validation tests 2. **npm run test:monorepo** validates workspace structure and dependencies 3. **npm run test:boundaries** validates import rules via ESLint 4. **npm run test:build** verifies all packages compile successfully 5. **npm run test:performance** baselines legacy provider latency 6. **npm run test:integration** runs plugin system integration tests 7. Tests are runnable locally AND in any CI/CD system 8. Zero external dependencies beyond npm/node 9. Test output includes clear pass/fail status with actionable error messages 10. Performance baseline metrics are saved for comparison

constraints.constraint: Tests must be CI/CD agnostic - no GitHub Actions specific features
Use standard npm scripts that any pipeline can execute
Follow Architecture ADR-007: Hybrid testing strategy (70/20/10 split)
Use real APIs where possible per FR65 (no mocking)
Performance: Plugin latency must match legacy ±5ms (NFR4)
Performance: Plugin loading must not increase startup >5s (NFR2)
Tests must run without external dependencies beyond npm/node
Test output must include clear pass/fail with actionable error messages
Baseline metrics must be saved for future comparison
